# Hearth DB changelog

Saved copy of CHANGELOG.md from the project's repository.

## 4.2.0 (2026-05-14)
- Maximum database size raised from 16 TiB to 64 TiB.
- Index rebuilds run online.
- `hearth backup -` streams to standard output.

## 4.1.0 (2026-01-20)
- Read replicas can lag by a configurable bound.
